items.title: Ruth Lion interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 15, 1998
items.q: Well yes I did public relations and artist promotion for him.

ctx.x: Did he have any experience in marketing? Did you have any experience in marketing that you later helped him with?

Well yes I did public relations and artist promotion for him. However, himself he just had a natural intellect. He had, in Germany, learned accounting and he was just, as I said before, a very careful, caring person. His concentration was so that it couldn’t be broken. I mean that was why I was saying that with Billie Holiday that, “Don’t come into my recording session,” and, “I mean we’re here for business.” And what Dexter Gordon said, “You just have to play better for Blue Note.” When the guys came on a Blue…
That’s a very high compliment, to get that from the musicians themselves, that they wanted to do their best. Who were some of the very first artists that he was able to record?
